summary: Veritone, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a September 30, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering of 20,000,000 common shares at an implied $0.75 per share, generating $15.0 million gross proceeds before expenses. Closing is expected on or about October 2, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds, plus existing cash, will repay and/or restructure a portion of convertible debt and fund working capital. The offering was made under an effective Form S-3 shelf; no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
